children: Infra-to-energy player Hazoor Multi Projects on Friday said it has secured an order worth over ₹200 crore in Tamil Nadu.
The scope of work includes civil and structural construction works for a residential project, the company said in an exchange filing.
The ₹207.44 crore project is to be executed within 30 months from the date of handover of the site in Chennai.
Hazoor Multi Projects (HMPL) is into renewable energy and building road projects on an engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) basis.

title: HMPL bags ₹200 cr construction project in Tamil Nadu
